svg.title: U.S. green-card grants by birthplace
svg.desc: Same observation years; separate vertical scales. Resident stocks and status grants have distinct periods and populations; not all physical arrivals. USCIS suspended routine in-person services March 18, 2020; phased reopening began June 4, 2020. COVID-19 context is not a universal ban or an estimate of COVID's effect. Rules, exemptions and reopening dates varied by destination and category. U.S. fiscal years run October-September; Macau approvals use calendar years. In-country status adjustments are not border arrivals.

g.font-family: DejaVu Serif, Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
g.text: Mainland China | Arrivals and adjustments | fiscal years 1989-2024
DHS/OHSS, country of birth, not nationality. Includes people already in the U.S. adjusting status. Fiscal
years end September 30. FY2015–2024 rounded to nearest ten; earlier source vintages use exact counts.
COVID: in-person services paused March 18-June 4, 2020; not a universal ban.
